summary: Assessed A-S consolidated Studio and T-AV v3 plan for GOAP pilot and project-neutral design. Current A-S Python source ~14,575 lines; plans cover 48 workgroups and 144 subsystem scopes, not fully deployed. Identified fixed five-repository TARGET_KEYS in source/api.py, 19-domain static composition/CI gate, and missing real connector/provider verification. Recommend freeze expansion; generalize registered projects through owner-approved config/adapters and perform staged fail-closed GOAP pilot before full rollout. No game source, issue, or production state changed by this assessment.
